title: Getting started with Team Accounts and Roles

question.author: member_281
question.body: I am setting up CloudBox and want to understand team accounts and roles. What does the current documentation say?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Business and Enterprise plans include team accounts with three roles. Admins manage membership, billing, and security settings. Members have full access to team folders according to their permissions. Guests are external people with limited access to specific folders only. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
